scope: Material-only screen for nominal2.0mm1050/1050A sheet, all individually documented standard sheet tempers found. No geometry, load capacity, stock qualification, post-paint strength guarantee or production release is implied.

levha_sheet.basis: Yield Strength N/mm2 (min); tensile strength limits; thickness-specific elongation rows encompass 2 mm. Table visually inspected from downloaded PDF.

bikar_1050a.basis: EN 485-2 sheet/plate minima for O/H111, H14 and H24; physical E69 GPa; F has no mechanical limits. H112 sheet rows begin at6mm.

hulamin_1050.basis: O and H14 proof minima at >1.5 to3mm; E69GPa for alloy.

tk_1050a.publisher: tk accelis Processing Europe, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Processing Europe
tk_1050a.basis: Independent O/H111, H22, H24 and H19 rows for1.5–3mm; H19 proof130MPa and tensile minimum150MPa at2mm.

alumeco_1050a.basis: Independent sheet proof/elongation/bend radius values. H16 >1.5 to4mm; other listed2mm rows >1.5 to3mm. H16 R1.5t; H18 R3t for90deg.

ucin_1050.basis: Independent H12 throughH28 proof values. No thickness ranges. O/H111 lists30MPa (differs from20MPa EN sheet minimum); H16 tensile125–160 differs from120–160 other sources. Not used to increase screening strength.

unqualified_conditions.reason: As-fabricated temper has no specified mechanical limits; a generic1050-F callout cannot inherit the20MPa minimum guaranteed for certifiedO/H111 sheet.
AvailableBIKARsheet table starts at6mm, not valid at2mm. Do not extrapolate thickplate or extrusion values.
Not interchangeable automatically with listed sheet tempers. Need matching product specification at2mm.

cautions: 1050 and EN AW-1050A are distinct designations; values above are an explicitly mapped conservative reference comparison, not an assertion that all chemical and delivery specifications are interchangeable.
H1x work-hardened and H2x partially-annealed tempers of the same hardness digit have different minimum proof stress. Do not combineH12/H22,H14/H24,H16/H26,H18/H28 into identical strength rows.
Known soft-sheet minima exist:O/H11120MPa. Unknown temper orF does not automatically guarantee that minimum.
Harder tempers do not increaseE appreciably, so purely elastic same-geometry deflection stays essentially unchanged.
Bend radii are generic informational recommendations; observedshoptooling and grain direction still govern. Null radius means not verified, not zero.
No thermal-cycle degradation assumed or certified. Cold-worked strength after actualpowdercure remains separate from as-suppliedstrength comparison.
One supplier table has an H28 thickness-range overlap (0.20–1.50 and0.51–3.00); at2mm only the latter contains the target, and common proof110MPa/tensile140MPa are unambiguous.
UCINno-thickness O/H11130MPa and H16tensile125MPa were not used to override the lower independentlyverifiedsheet values.

screening.type: Analytical simply supported bare-sheet strip sensitivity; not an assembled-enclosure rating or conservative bound
limitations: Real feet are small compliant contact patches, not continuous support lines.
Folded walls, two-dimensional plate action and printed-support stiffness are omitted.
CLEAR/BANK have perimeter and boss-ring bearing, not full-area bearing.
Large linear deflections would invalidate small-deflection and fixed-contact assumptions.
700 N is a provisional static case; owner scale readings do not establish impact peak.
screening.conclusion: All listed tempers have minimum proof strength below both 700 N strip stress cases. This flags unresolved assembled bending; it does not predict physical enclosure failure or certify any temper.
